Verdict: FIX FIRST @ 14024311a28d6027148612808100e30556e48dc4

Reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5, by hand (Bora's account; no reviewer App yet). Independent of the implementation seat (GPT Sol · high). Range `12889255..14024311`. Record: `keporkak-project/toy/review-001.md`.

## Blockers

### B1 — the specs can stop running and `just check` stays green
**Where:** [lib/build.gradle.kts#L18-L24](https://github.com/Collite/kp-toy/blob/14024311a28d6027148612808100e30556e48dc4/lib/build.gradle.kts#L18-L24) · [SkeletonSpec.kt](https://github.com/Collite/kp-toy/blob/14024311a28d6027148612808100e30556e48dc4/lib/src/test/kotlin/org/collite/kptoy/SkeletonSpec.kt)
**Violated:** DONE item 1 ("`just check` is green … the placeholder spec runs and passes") · RW-14 / RW-3: a spec that would stay green without its behaviour.
**Probe (reviewer's worktree, discarded):** commented out `useJUnitPlatform()` → `rm -rf lib/build && just check` → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`, zero specs executed, no test result written. Gradle 8.14.3 does not fail a test task that runs nothing, so "runs and passes" is not observed.
**Missing test:** the build must fail when the `lib` test task executes zero specs. Regression: with `useJUnitPlatform()` removed (or any change that leaves no spec discovered), `just check` goes red.

### B2 — DONE item 3 has no spec
**Where:** [gradle/libs.versions.toml#L1-L4](https://github.com/Collite/kp-toy/blob/14024311a28d6027148612808100e30556e48dc4/gradle/libs.versions.toml#L1-L4); the PR backs it with a manual check only.
**Violated:** DONE item 3 ("the version catalog has no dynamic version") · RW-14 (classified blocker by Bora on request).
**Missing test:** a spec, named as its sentence, that reads the version catalog and fails on any dynamic version — `+`, `latest.*`, a range (`[`, `(`, `,`), `-SNAPSHOT`, or a library/plugin version that is neither an exact pin nor a `version.ref` to one. Regression: adding `foo = "1.+"` to `[versions]` makes `just check` red.

## Follow-ups
- #2 — CI actions on deprecated Node 20; setup-java v4 deprecated.

## Verification
- Head confirmed `14024311`; CI [43411072431](https://github.com/Collite/kp-toy/actions/runs/43411072431) (pull_request) and [43410789830](https://github.com/Collite/kp-toy/actions/runs/43410789830) (push) green — 2 passed, 0 failed.
- `just check` in a fresh worktree at the head (JDK 21.0.13, just 1.59.0) → 2 passed, `lib/build/libs/lib.jar` only.
- Jar spec bites: adding a second jar task → `the library builds into one jar() FAILED`.
- Wrapper: `gradle-wrapper.jar` sha256 and `distributionSha256Sum` match services.gradle.org for 8.14.3.
- Catalog read by hand: three exact pins, every entry by `version.ref` — holds today (B2 is about it staying held).
- `keporkak` master still has no `gradle/libs.versions.toml`, so T2's "same version as keporkak" has nothing to match.
- Fence holds: no main sources, no second module, no parsing/formatting, nothing published.
- DONE item 2 (CI green on master after the merge) is not reviewable before the merge; the workflow runs on every push.

Verdict: PASS — follow-ups filed @ 028e9e2dece9c94f65f3c0da144e6f2ce3c9f013

Re-review (round 1 of the ladder) of TOY S0.1 against review-001's blockers. Reviewer: Claude Opus 5.5, by hand.

| blocker | verdict | note |
|---|---|---|
| B1 — specs can stop running, `just check` stays green | **closed** | `verifyTestExecution` ([lib/build.gradle.kts#L29-L54](https://github.com/Collite/kp-toy/blob/028e9e2dece9c94f65f3c0da144e6f2ce3c9f013/lib/build.gradle.kts#L29-L54)) fails `check` on zero executed specs; [checks/BuildRegressions.java](https://github.com/Collite/kp-toy/blob/028e9e2dece9c94f65f3c0da144e6f2ce3c9f013/checks/BuildRegressions.java) runs it from `just check`. Probe: `useJUnitPlatform()` commented out → `lib:test executed zero specs`, BUILD FAILED. Probe: guard neutralised → both B1 regressions FAILED, `just check` red. |
| B2 — DONE item 3 has no spec | **closed** | `the version catalog has no dynamic version` ([SkeletonSpec.kt#L18-L23](https://github.com/Collite/kp-toy/blob/028e9e2dece9c94f65f3c0da144e6f2ce3c9f013/lib/src/test/kotlin/org/collite/kptoy/SkeletonSpec.kt#L18-L23)) reads the real catalog; the catalog is a test input. Probe: `foo = "1.+"` in `[versions]` → that spec FAILED, BUILD FAILED. |

No finding introduced by the fix.

Verification: CI 43419756768 (pull_request) and 43419748450 (push) on 028e9e2, both green — 5 specs passed, 3 build regressions passed. `just check` in a clean throwaway worktree at the head (JDK 21.0.13) → same counts. All probes throwaway and reverted; no credentials used.

Follow-up still open: #2. DONE item 2 (CI green on master) is observable only after the merge.
